title: AI agent
extract: An AI agent is an artificial intelligence program that can make decisions, pursue goals, and take actions independent of humans. Agentic AI contrasts with tool-like AI use for narrow, specific tasks such as answering questions - as with chatbots in the non-agentic forms that were common in 2023, or with traditional machine learning algorithms.
